text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in error when the treatment arm replaces the reference arm, in percentage points of capacity; more negative is better. Mean absolute error, except P4, which is CRPS. P1: L1 minus B0. P2: AN minus L1, on the last 8 months only. P3: S2 minus L2. P4: L1 minus B0 on CRPS. P5: L1 minus B0 in one XGBoost model shared by all plants. Dot: estimate at each hyperparameter setting. Line: 99% interval from resampling whole months. Zero: no change. The words at the right of a row give the verdict from both settings.'
text.tspan: Change in error when the treatment arm replaces the reference arm, in percentage points of capacity; more negative
is better. Mean absolute error, except P4, which is CRPS.
P1: L1 minus B0. P2: AN minus L1, on the last 8 months only. P3: S2 minus L2. P4: L1 minus B0 on CRPS. P5: L1 minus
B0 in one XGBoost model shared by all plants.
Dot: estimate at each hyperparameter setting. Line: 99% interval from resampling whole months. Zero: no change. The

g.aria-label: Symbol legend titled 'Hyperparameter setting' for fill color and stroke color with 2 values: primary, sensitivity

text.font-family: Matter Semi Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace
Matter Semi Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace

text.aria-label: Title text 'Lagged power means a lag: the power at the same clock hour on an earlier whole day. Day-ahead means lead-day 1, the forecast for the day after the day it is issued. An arm is one forecast configuration. Each planned contrast, P1 to P5, is a treatment arm minus a reference arm. Each row names its reference arm's own error. CRPS is the continuous ranked probability score, approximated from nine quantiles (0.1 to 0.9). The primary hyperparameter setting is depth 6, learning rate 0.05, 500 rounds, and row subsampling 0.8. The sensitivity setting is depth 4, learning rate 0.03, 1,200 rounds, and stronger regularisation. Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast). L2: L1 plus that hour's weather forecast. S2: a two-step forecast that adds a first-stage forecast and its residual at the lag hour. AN: the analogue ensemble: the mean, the forecast clear-sky index and the spread of the power (rescaled by clear-sky irradiance) on the 5 of the last 30 days whose forecast clear-sky index was closest to the target's. All rows are planned: written into the study plan before any result existed.'
text.tspan: Lagged power means a lag: the power at the same clock hour on an earlier whole day. Day-ahead means lead-day 1, the forecast
for the day after the day it is issued. An arm is one forecast configuration. Each planned contrast, P1 to P5, is a treatment
arm minus a reference arm. Each row names its reference arm's own error. CRPS is the continuous ranked probability score,
approximated from nine quantiles (0.1 to 0.9).
The primary hyperparameter setting is depth 6, learning rate 0.05, 500 rounds, and row subsampling 0.8. The sensitivity
setting is depth 4, learning rate 0.03, 1,200 rounds, and stronger regularisation.
Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was
issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast). L2: L1 plus that hour's weather forecast. S2: a two-step
forecast that adds a first-stage forecast and its residual at the lag hour. AN: the analogue ensemble: the mean, the forecast
clear-sky index and the spread of the power (rescaled by clear-sky irradiance) on the 5 of the last 30 days whose forecast
clear-sky index was closest to the target's.
All rows are planned: written into the study plan before any result existed.
